segments.text:
ALl those that are justified, God vouchsafeth, in, and for his only Son Jesus Christ, to make partakers of the grace of Adoption: by which they are taken into the number, and enjoy the liberties and priviledges of the children of God, have his Name put upon them c, receive the spirit of Adoption, have access to the throne of grace with boldness, are inabled to cry Abba, Father, are pitied, protected, provided
for, and chastned by him, as by a Father: yet never cast off, but sealed to the day of redemption, and inherit the promises, as heirs of everlasting Salvation.
